content.value: Riverbend Ivanhoe is a premium luxury residential apartment development

situated in one of Melbourne's most historic and leafy suburbs, operating as a flagship location under the elite Norus project umbrella. The development delivers high-end boutique living spaces that balance sophisticated inner-city architectural design with serene, natural riverside surroundings.

The technical scope of this task involved developing a dedicated, conversion-optimized sub-location landing page within the HubSpot CMS platform. To capture high-intent property buyers, the static HTML mockup was converted into a flexible, fully responsive HubSpot template. Because standard drag-and-drop mechanics cannot support micro-interactions natively, custom modules were engineered with raw HTML/CSS and interactive JavaScript layers. This approach allows non-technical marketing managers to update specific property details while preserving a premium user experience.

The core challenge lay in adapting a complex, deeply informational real estate asset pipeline into an intuitive, modular browsing experience. Unlike broad brand pages, a specific development landing page must simultaneously showcase architectural concepts, raw floor plans, lifestyle community markers, and real-time physical construction updates without causing layout fragmentation or slow load speeds.
The development strategy utilized a "Location & Validation" narrative framework to guide high-net-worth buyers down the funnel:
The page opens with an immersive, wide-angle streetscape render of the development (

The upper funnel details the physical property interiors using an alternating two-column grid layout (

). Custom CSS transitions reveal content elegantly as the user scrolls.
The Interactive Choice & Floor Plan Matrix:

The mid-funnel transitions from abstract lifestyle imagery to actionable data. A structural residence selector leads into an "Apartment of the Week" feature block, pairing a data sheet with a crisp, high-resolution architectural blueprint layout.

To prove neighborhood value and physical progress, the lower funnel integrates a nine-quadrant community lifestyle grid, a location map, and a live "Project On Track" construction status module featuring aerial drone photography.
To achieve the alternating horizontal text-and-image rows under sections like

, custom HubSpot modules were coded using HubL (HubSpot Markup Language) fields. This custom setup enables smooth image-to-text alignment across all screen resolutions, bypassing the restrictive constraints of HubSpot's default layout styles.
